citedMandateClauses: 9. Routine housekeeping (renewing service providers at the same or lower cost, updating addresses, ratifying elections) is acceptable: vote for it.
4. Vote for security fixes, audits, bug bounties, emergency patches, key rotations and upgrades that reduce trust in any single party.
rationale: The proposal is a routine housekeeping action to rotate Sentinel addresses for the Uniswap Earn vaults due to Gauntlet's infrastructure upgrade. It involves no transfer of treasury assets, no new grants, and no changes to risk parameters or privileged roles beyond the specific Sentinel rotation. The on-chain actions (six calls to setIsSentinel) match the description exactly. This falls under Mandate Rule 9 (routine housekeeping) and supports Rule 4 (security/maintenance) by ensuring the vaults are managed by current, valid addresses. There is no evidence of manipulation or hidden instructions.
